decisions.statement: The rules a player has are read from the rule pages of that player's account.
A rule a player changes is written back as a page of its own.
A rule page no rule wants is taken away in the same save.
No rule reaches the settings blob.
The item rules and the buy rules are still read from the settings blob.
The settings blob is asked for under `files`.
A blob answering as its file's ending is refused rather than read as unset.
One copy of the blob is held here.
A write carries the whole blob merged onto the blob last read rather than one panel's section.
The panels outside this package read this copy rather than opening a second copy.
A write before the blob is read is refused.
A rule the read refuses is handed on as the words that refusal said.
A write while any rule is unread is refused.

definition: one player's inventory settings, read and written for a browser
